##### Project general facts

Reem Eleven is a modern residential tower developed by SAAS Properties, featuring a contemporary architectural style with a glass façade and spanning 19 residential floors plus five podium levels. The project offers furnished studios, 1-bedroom apartments, and 2-3 bedroom residences, each designed with a focus on refined living spaces and expansive balconies providing city and waterfront views. The complex includes a ground floor and podium levels enhancing the overall residential experience.

Amenities at Reem Eleven include a private SPA, a modern cinema, and smart home systems integrated into select apartments. Residents also benefit from access to rooftop pools with lounge areas and a water filtration system.  The residences are equipped with an equipped kitchen, and modern finishing with high-quality materials throughout. 

Select apartments feature private elevators providing direct access to expansive interiors, embodying an atmosphere of sophistication and tranquility. These residences are fully furnished, offering a complete and ready-to-move-in living environment.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Reem Island is a mixed-use, fast-developing area in the northeast of Abu Dhabi, about 1,970 ft. from the mainland of the emirate. Nearby are Saadiyat Island and Al Maryah Island.

Most residential buildings are located in close proximity to the sea and beaches, and provide the opportunity for a resort lifestyle close to all the amenities of a major metropolis. Al Reem Island has a well-developed social and entertainment infrastructure, with banks and commercial facilities. It is a lively area with lots of parks and sports areas.  

Al Reem Island became one of the first freehold zones in Abu Dhabi. This has attracted a flood of investment in the development of the area. Modern architectural style prevails in the development with the exception of the community of villas in the classic Moroccan and Spanish style.
